subject: Parallax security readiness — IR & BCP evidence request
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@parallax.ai>, Sana Kapoor <sana.k@parallax.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Parallax discovery — post-call recap & security intake

Hi Miguel / Sana,

Thanks again for the intro call today — appreciate the context on where Parallax plans to embed the recommendation engine. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the security/compliance items we discussed: 

- Redwood needs a short package so our security and legal teams can move the contract and procurement work forward: SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 status + timeline), summary of recent penetration test results, GDPR/HIPAA posture (if applicable), and your incident response / breach notification timelines and BCP/DR runbooks or a redacted excerpt.
- We also asked to kick off our vendor security questionnaire to capture network, encryption, access control, and logging details. I can send the questionnaire directly or you can upload to the secure folder.
- For incident response: please share your notification windows (internal detection -> customer notification), escalation contacts, and sample incident notification template you would use for customer-facing notices. For GDPR specifically we try to confirm the 72-hour notification capability; for HIPAA we expect internal time-to-assess and notification cadence.

If possible, can you provide the items below by EOD next Wednesday (6/4)? If some items require legal review, a partial upload is fine — flag what’s redacted.

Requested deliverables (initial):
1) SOC 2 Type II report or status + expected completion date
2) Penetration test executive summary (last 12 months)
3) IR contact list + escalation path (name, role, email, phone)
4) BCP/DR runbook excerpt (RTO/RPO, recovery steps)
5) Confirmation of GDPR/HIPAA applicability and notification windows

Preferred upload: secure Google Drive link (I included a Drive link below) or direct upload to our vendor portal: https://redwood.app/vendor-questionnaire/PRX-47

Once you upload, I’ll loop in our security lead and procurement to review and set a short call to walk through the items next week.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
sean@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0193
From: Miguel Santos <miguel@parallax.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sana Kapoor <sana.k@parallax.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Parallax discovery — post-call recap & security intake

Sean — thanks for the clear list. Attaching the SOC 2 Type II we have from our vendor assessment last year and the high-level pen-test summary (redacted).

You'll find: parallax_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf and parallax_pen_test_summary_2024.pdf attached. 

A few clarifications from our side:
- GDPR: we are processing EU personal data for a subset of customers; our legal team confirms a 72-hour window for external notification once incidents are confirmed.
- HIPAA: Parallax is not a business associate for the current PoC, but we do maintain health-data handling policies and can supply relevant controls if required.
- IR notification: Our standard customer notification template is internal-only at the moment; we can provide a customer-facing template after a short redaction review.

We will upload the full IR contact list and BCP runbook excerpt by Friday (5/30) to the Drive folder you provided (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-parallax-security). If you'd prefer secure SFTP, let me know and I can arrange with our ops team.

Thanks — Miguel
Miguel Santos
Head of Security Operations
Parallax AI
miguel@parallax.ai | +1 (617) 555-3344

Attachments:
- parallax_SOC2_TypeII_2024.pdf (attachment stub)
- parallax_pen_test_summary_2024.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Parallax discovery — post-call recap & security intake

FYI — Miguel uploaded the SOC2 and pen-test summary. Please review and confirm the gaps we should flag.

Ask: Marissa, can you schedule a quick qualifying call with Parallax next week to go over IR timelines and agree on the mutual action plan? Ben — once security confirms acceptability, can you prep preliminary commercial terms tied to a 6-month PoC?

I'll share the Drive link in the ticket.

--
Sean
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@parallax.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Parallax discovery — next steps & questionnaire

Hi Miguel — great, thanks for the uploads.

Attached is our vendor questionnaire to speed the intake: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf. If you can complete and return by EOD Tuesday (6/3) we'll book a 30-minute review on Wednesday to align on the IR / BCP items and any redactions.

One quick question on log retention: in the SOC 2 you indicate logs are retained for 90 days. Can you confirm whether security event logs (SIEM) are archived longer for investigatory purposes (6-12 months)? That will be important for some of our customers in regulated verticals.

Thanks — looking forward to the review call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0128

Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (attachment stub)
From: Anil Reddy <anil.reddy@parallax.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Miguel Santos <miguel@parallax.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Parallax — IR contact list and BCP / notification clarifications

Sean / Marissa — looping in Parallax legal to provide the BCP/IR clarifications you requested. See answers below and attached IR contact list.

1) Notification windows:
   - GDPR: confirmed 72-hour external notification once incident scope and impact are determined; initial acknowledgement to customers within 24 hours when we detect a confirmed data incident.
   - HIPAA: not applicable for the PoC, but as a practice we aim for a 60-day internal investigation window for covered events; customer notification timing depends on the specific contractual requirement.

2) BCP / DR: our primary RTO is 4 hours for critical services and RPO is 15 minutes for customer-facing clusters. The runbook excerpt we plan to upload contains failover steps and vendor escalation points.

3) Logs and retention: security event logs are retained in SIEM for 12 months; full raw packet captures are kept 30 days. Audit logs for ACL changes are retained for 2 years.

4) Delivery: attached is parallax_ir_contact_list.xlsx with names and phone numbers. We will place the full runbook excerpt in the Drive folder and can also provide a redacted PDF if you require.

If Redwood has a preferred legal or security POC for formal evidence transfer, please point us to the email or secure upload method and we'll push the artifacts there.

Regards,
Anil Reddy
General Counsel
Parallax AI
anil.reddy@parallax.ai

Attachment: parallax_ir_contact_list.xlsx (attachment stub)
